adaptation_notes: Dear ImGui has no aligned allocation hook; the facade's unaligned path is enough.

Dear ImGui has no runtime log or assert hook, so neither probed diagnostics rule applies to it. Routing IM_ASSERT needs a variant built with the composition's IMGUI_USER_CONFIG (guidance rule diagnostics.compile-time-asserts).
DebugCheckVersionAndDataLayout is what IMGUI_CHECKVERSION() calls; it also asserts on mismatch.
